info.title: RetroAchievementsSharp CLI
info.description: A cross-platform .NET tool for RetroAchievements hashing. Native C# port of the RAHasher/rcheevos hashing engine with PS3, CHD, RVZ/WIA, 3DS, cartridge, disc, zip, and m3u support.

options.name: -s
options.description: (optional) specifies where supplementary files are stored (typically a path to RetroArch/system)
